blocks.html: WinTAK requires Windows to be set to English with the United States region — do this before you install the app. Work in pairs if you can: one reads, one drives.

slides.title: Search for Time and Language
slides.html: Open the Windows settings: type Time and Language into the search bar (bottom-left).

slides.title: Open Region settings
slides.html: First change the region. In Time and Language, select Region from the sidebar.

slides.title: Set region to United States
slides.html: Set the country or region to United States. Make sure the regional format is also English (United States).

slides.title: Set the display language to English (US)
slides.html: Back in the sidebar, select Language. Set the Windows display language to English (United States).

slides.title: Sign out and back in
slides.html: Finalize the display-language change by signing out and signing back in.

slides.title: Language set
slides.html: If English is now your display language, the localization is complete. If English was not available to choose, the next two steps add it — otherwise you're ready to install WinTAK.

slides.title: If English is missing: add a language pack
slides.html: If English isn't in the display-language list, press Add a language, search for English, and press Install language pack. Wait for it to install.

slides.title: Select English, then sign out and in
slides.html: Once installed, select English as the display language as above, then sign out and back in. Windows is now localized — next, download and install WinTAK.
